class.name: EntityManager
class.brief_description: Central authority for ECS entity lifecycle and component management.
class.description: The [EntityManager] is a singleton that manages 64-bit generational entity IDs and their associated component data. It handles high-speed component registration, retrieval, and entity destruction.

link.title: ECS Core Handbook - Vol 0: Getting Started

method.name: create_entity
method.description: Spawns a new entity and returns its unique 64-bit ID.

method.name: destroy_entity
method.description: Immediately destroys the entity and all its components.

method.name: is_entity_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the entity ID is alive and matches the current generation.

method.name: get_active_entity_count
method.description: Returns the total number of currently alive entities.

method.name: add_component_untyped
method.description: Adds a component to the entity from GDScript.
